description: This file contains unit tests for the RecipeFilters class and associated recipe filtering logic in a Flutter application. It tests matching behavior based on cuisines, diets, and cooking time buckets, as well as serialization logic and facet count calculations.

classes.name: Recipe
classes.description: Model class representing a recipe with id, title, image URL, description, ingredients, directions, cuisine, diets, and cooking time.

classes.name: RecipeFilters
classes.description: Class representing filter criteria for recipes, including selected cuisines, diets, and cooking time buckets.

classes.name: CookingTimeBucket
classes.description: Enum defining time categories for cooking durations, such as under 15 minutes, 30-60 minutes, etc.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that runs the set of unit tests for the RecipeFilters class and recipe matching logic.
